text: 金十数据11月12日讯，当虹科技公告，公司此前审议通过拟申请注册发行最高不超过5亿元科技创新债券的议案，近日收到中国银行间市场交易商协会出具的《接受注册通知书》，交易商协会决定接受公司科技创新债券注册。本次注册基础品种为定向债务融资工具，注册金额5亿元，注册额度自通知书落款之日起2年内有效，由国信证券股份有限公司主承销，公司可在注册有效期内分期定向发行，将结合资金需求及市场情况择机实施发行事宜。
text_en: Jinshi Data, November 12: Arcvideo Technology announced that the company had previously reviewed and approved a proposal to apply for registration and issuance of no more than 500 million yuan of sci-tech innovation bonds, and recently received the Notice of Acceptance of Registration issued by the National Association of Financial Market Institutional Investors, which decided to accept the registration of the company's sci-tech innovation bonds. The underlying variety for this registration is a targeted debt financing instrument, with a registered amount of 500 million yuan. The registration quota is valid for two years from the date of the notice, with Guosen Securities Co., Ltd. as lead underwriter. The company may issue in tranches on a targeted basis during the registration validity period, and will implement the issuance at an appropriate time in light of funding needs and market conditions.
